caption: The drawing depicts a detailed design of a wrought iron gate in black ink on a beige background. The gate is composed of two main panels drawn side-by-side: the left panel shows the front view and is densely filled with symmetrical, ornate patterns made up of scrolling acanthus leaves, spirals, and floral motifs within a rectangular frame. The corners of the gate frame contain stylized flower rosettes. Near the center of the left panel, there is a circular motif with a human face surrounded by wings or drapery, integrating into the organic forms. The right panel shows a side view with the same rectangular framework, featuring two diagonal crossbars meeting at a central medallion and decorative elements at the top. Light blue pencil lines indicate additional structural or architectural elements behind the ironwork, including angular shapes and outlines, providing context for the gate's installation. The image is evenly shaded, with precise linework highlighting the intricacy and craftsmanship of the design.
title: Cast Iron Gate
